description: Get the one-line terminal command that installs a Lookbk skill, optionally for one agent (claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, github-copilot, opencode, vs-code) and for the user’s home folder or the current project. The server never runs it; the agent runs it in the user’s terminal.

agent.description: Which agent will use it. Leave out to install for all.

scope.description: "user" installs to the home folder (default), "project" into the current repository.

name: get_install_command
title: Get install command
